_说明: 自定义运镜表。在「H3 提示词装配」节点的 camera_json 填本文件绝对路径即可生效。key = 分镜里写的短名，value = 展开给 H3 的镜头语言。可以覆盖内置项（内置表见 core/prompt_build.py 的 CAMERA_PRESETS）。
slow_reveal: very slow reveal, camera drifts sideways while the subject stays centered
manga_panel_push: sudden snap push in, dramatic emphasis like a manga impact panel
speed_lines: fast push in with radial speed lines, high energy
rain_window: static shot through a rain-streaked window, foreground water droplets
overhead_topdown: top-down overhead shot, flat manga-like composition
shoulder_follow: over-the-shoulder tracking shot following the subject from behind
freeze_frame: near-static shot with only hair and cloth moving slightly in the wind
